findings.note: ScrollView removed; landscape uses the same non-scrolling drag mechanics as portrait. Interaction risk retired.
Portrait branch is inline upper/tableau/Spacer, byte-identical to pre-commit.

3 of 4 new pins (kingsFirst/jacksDownFirst/suitsTopDown 'if e.rank==...{ k+=1 }' style lines) ALSO appear verbatim in the objViolated HUD mirror, so an authoritative-only checker bug leaves the string alive in the mirror and the guard passes. Fix: pin the DISTINCTIVE violation branches unique to the authoritative checkers — 'else if e.rank == 1 && e.end == "up" && k < 4 { return false }' (kings), '... && j < 4 { return false }' (jacks), '... && !kd[e.suit] { return false }' (suits-top-down) — which differ from the mirror's 'return true'.

No-scroll landscape floors cardW at 32pt; a long column (~12+) on a short viewport overflows below the screen with no way to reach the bottom cards. Mitigate: compress the tableau fan in landscape (smaller overlap factor) so columns fit more cards; keep tappable card size. Residual (extreme-long-column landscape on small phones) accepted as a documented known-minor pending on-device tuning.
